recipes.name: Pumpkin Pecan Pie
ingredients_raw: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch single crust pie

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Stir together one egg, pumpkin, 1/3 cup sugar, and spice. Spread over bottom of pie shell.
Combine 2 eggs, corn syrup, 1/2 cup sugar, butter and vanilla. Stir in nuts. Spoon over pumpkin mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until filling is set, about 50 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Pumpkin Pecan Pie
raw_recipe.description: This pumpkin pecan pie has a rich and nutty pumpkin filling for the perfect combination of two holiday favorites.

review.reviewBody: Really easy recipe and delicious. I baked the pumpkin layer for a few minutes first and cooled it a bit so that the layers would be more distinct.

Taste delicious!!! I made them into cupcake sized tarts! I uploaded a picture too! So pretty and great tasting! It made 12 tarts. I used foil liners without the paper liners that came in them. I baked them 40 minutes! They came out perfectly! Yummy!!!

This recipe was so good! There was 1/4 slice left after Thanksgiving (with 3 other pie options available). I also cooked the pumpkin layer for about 10 minutes, let it cool and then added the pecan layer. I put closer to a tablespoon of pumpkin pie spice in the pumpkin layer. And I added a little more pecans (maybe an add'l 1/4 cup). Super good pie, love love love it!

Recipe is straightforward as written. Absolutely the best pecan pie I've ever made combining my hubby's favorite and mine with the pumpkin. I made the following adjustments: Add pumpkin mix to Frozen pie shell and bake for 10 minutes. Split 2/3 cup corn syrup: 1/3 each corn and agave syrups Split half cup sugar: 1/4 each white and brown sugars Chopped pecans instead of whole, not blended into mixture but sprinkled on top. Total bake 60 minutes covering edge of crust at the 40 minute mark. Let cool completely. My slices cut perfectly! Outstanding, Thanks!

This was very good and easy to make. I followed others advice and added more milk as 2/3 cup is definitely not enough. Also I baked the pumpkin layer 12 mins before adding the pecan pie layer. It still required 50 additional mins to sufficiently cook.

I've made it before and we loved it. This time I made it and the pecan pie part did not set up. It sat up after 24 hrs. But not completely. I figured out what was wrong. I used a frozen pie crust that I thawed out , but did not get to room temperature. By doing this there was to much moisture and that why it was soupy. I laid out a frozen pie crust last night on the counter and overed it up. It thawed out all night. Then this morning I made the pie. It turned out perfect. This is a simple easy pie to make. And always a big hit.
Very very good, I also baked the pumkin layer for about 5-10 minutes to let it set slightly and it turned out great, both layers were very distinct and it looked wonderful and tasted better!
This was SOOO GOOD! I followed others comments and made in a deep dish, double to pie spice and added a few extra pecans just because I love them. Thanks for a great recipe!
Recipe should state that mixture requires a deep dish pie crust. What fit in the pan was great but I missed the extra pecan filling I had to discard. Rave reviews by family!

This was my first pumpkin/pecan pie and it was good, but could have been better. There wasn't enough pumpkin taste and I doubled the pumpkin pie spice amount. Next time I will use a great pumpkin pie recipe cut in half and mix it with a great pecan pie recipe cut in half.
great and easy pie. I usually make 2 separate pies, one pecan and one pumpkin. They liked this better than either one separately
Epic fail. Like others, mine turned out one soupy mess even with extra baking time. Would not recommend.
Made this pie for my sons work Christmas party. HUGE SUCCESS!
2/3 a cup corn syrup? I followed the directions skeptically but turned out like I thought: a syrup mess on top. Didn't solidify at all.
Made this twice already and perfect for Thanksgiving. Might be my new favorite

This recipe neglects to state that it is one 15 OUNCE can of Pumpkin!! A lot of the problems some reviewers have mentioned I think it's because they are using a larger size can. With that said, I followed this recipe exactly, didn't change a thing. I used a regular 9 inch pie plate. DID NOT NEED a deep dish!! The pumpkin does not come out as firm as I expected. I took this to a party and it got rave reviews!! Most people I talked to said they preferred the pumpkin was not firm like a traditional pumpkin pie. I am not a fan of pumpkin pie, but this was great!! The pecans make a big difference!! Coming from me that says a lot. I will definitely make this again.
Great pie. Double the pecans and it's way better
I’ve actually made this recipe many times and it is our favorite pie! Very easy and delicious.
Absolutely delicious! I did need to cook it an extra 5 min.
